title: Charlie Petersson captures reflective mornings in soulful new single “Those Mornings”
htmlContent:
Charlie Petersson is back with a new song titled “Those Mornings,” which is a heartfelt song that brings back memories of simpler times. This track is the second sneak peek of his debut album, which is coming out this spring. It beautifully combines elements from the past with a modern feel.

“Those Mornings” creates a warm and comforting atmosphere, reminding listeners of artists like Gavin DeGraw, Daniel Powter, Jason Mraz, and Robbie Williams. The song takes you back to when life felt slower and full of possibilities. The song’s production is polished but still feels natural, allowing the emotions at its core to shine brightly.

https://open.spotify.com/album/7c5oX66wtD0f9Au4HmdXuC?si=DLmtuxgyRXifQmjnQs_AXA

“Those Mornings” is a song that taps into memories while being relatable for anyone who has ever yearned for the magic of the past. If this single is anything to go by, Petersson’s upcoming debut album promises to be remarkable. With “Those Mornings,” he honors the artists who inspired him while establishing a unique sound of his own.
